description: What the MCP runtime suite must notice (lib/mcp/sdk.mjs): where the SDK is looked for, the pinned version, the package boundary, the check of what was loaded, the single import.

mutations.name: R1-any-version
mutations.what: a copy of another client version is accepted

mutations.name: R2-export-escapes
mutations.what: an export that leaves the package folder is accepted

mutations.name: R3-override-not-exclusive
mutations.what: CHATMCP_MCP_RUNTIME_DIR is tried before the default folders instead of alone

mutations.name: R4-dev-before-installed
mutations.what: the checkout's copy is preferred to the installed one

mutations.name: R5-loaded-parts-unchecked
mutations.what: a copy without the classes the Hub uses is accepted

mutations.name: R6-imported-every-time
mutations.what: the SDK is imported again on every call

mutations.name: R7-first-folder-only
mutations.what: the search stops at the first folder that has no SDK
